steps.en: Install AgentChat plus a model-client extension
steps.zh: 装 AgentChat 和一个模型客户端扩展

steps.en: Define expert agents, each with a system message, and hand them to a lead agent as tools
steps.zh: 定义各带指令的专家 agent，包成主 agent 的工具

steps.en: Run a task on the lead agent
steps.zh: 让主 agent 跑一个任务
steps.code: agent.run_stream(task="What is the integral of x^2?")

steps.en: Calls the model; the model picks a tool or an expert agent to call
steps.zh: 调用模型，由模型决定调哪个工具或哪个专家 agent

steps.en: Runs that expert's own model loop and returns its last message as the tool result
steps.zh: 跑那个专家自己的模型循环，把它最后一句话当工具结果交回

steps.en: Repeats until the lead answers or hits max_tool_iterations, streaming each message
steps.zh: 循环到出答案或到 max_tool_iterations，消息流式输出

value.en: Several LLM agents cooperate on one task without you writing the message routing or the tool-call loop
value.zh: 几个大模型 agent 协作完成一个任务，消息路由和工具调用循环都不用你写

sources: https://github.com/microsoft/autogen README — Installation (pip install -U "autogen-agentchat" "autogen-ext[openai]"); Quickstart / Multi-Agent Orchestration (AgentTool(math_agent, return_value_as_last_message=True), max_tool_iterations=10, Console(agent.run_stream(task="What is the integral of x^2?")))
